selection_method: 12 of the 200 proposed pilot-cohort hotels, one per launch city, chosen to cover: varied cities (all 12 represented), both independent and chain-flagged entities, both high and gate-borderline confidence, and 2 cases judged the most discutable in the full list -- see each hotel's selection_reason. Not a random or statistically representative sample; a deliberately varied inspection set, same spirit as Phase 2's 18-hotel inspection.

hotels.selection_reason: Most discutable pick #1. The name ("Boys' Home") strongly suggests a juvenile residential-care institution, not a bookable hotel -- despite formally passing every automated gate (confidence 81.8, dedupe 100, matched Overture's lodging taxonomy). This is exactly the failure mode entity_qa.py's English-market name-pattern filter is built to catch, and "home" isn't currently one of its exclusion markers -- adding it isn't done here, only flagged, since a blind marker addition risks new false exclusions elsewhere (same caution as every entity_qa change this project has made). If this is genuinely a hotel with an unfortunate name, publishing it is harmless; if it's a mislabeled institution, publishing it would be a real, reputationally serious category error. Recommend the owner verify this one specifically before it goes live, independent of its gate status.
